reveal_en: The last pharaoh of Egypt, Cleopatra, lived closer to the invention of the iPhone than she did to the construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza. The pyramid was built around 2560 BCE; Cleopatra died in 30 BCE.
reveal_zh: 埃及末代法老克利奥帕特拉生活的时代，离iPhone发明比离吉萨大金字塔建成更近。金字塔约在公元前2560年建成，而艳后卒于公元前30年。
meaning_en: Our perception of historical distance often collapses vast eras, obscuring the profound lengths of time that truly separate ancient events.
meaning_zh: 我们对历史距离的认知常压缩漫长时代，掩盖了古老事件间真正惊人的时间跨度。

visual.motion: Timeline markers appearing and receding, emphasizing relative distances.
